title: Quick payment from the record
summary: Create → Quick payment: invoices and charges in one step, with the patient already chosen.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide continues once their record is open.

steps.title: Create
steps.details: Everything that can be created for this patient: clinical, financial and scheduling.

steps.title: Quick payment
steps.details: Opens the payment wizard with this patient.

steps.title: Payment wizard
steps.details: Choose what to charge (quote, pending invoice or separate items), review the amounts and record the payment. It needs an open cash register.
